title: A resolution recognizing religious freedom as a fundamental right, expressing support for international religious freedom as a cornerstone of United States foreign policy, and expressing concern over increased threats to and attacks on religious freedom around the world.
latestAction: Placed on Senate Legislative Calendar under General Orders. Calendar No. 105.
policyArea: Civil Rights and Liberties, Minority Issues
summary: This resolution recognizes religious freedom as a fundamental human right and expresses concern over threats to religious freedom around the world, such as through harassment, violence, and imprisonment.
